topic: The Uncertainty Principle: The Duality of Time and Frequency
target_audience: Undergraduate students in engineering, physics, or mathematics

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Musical Note vs. The Drum Beat
lecture_lines: Fourier transforms decompose signals into frequencies.
A pure sine wave has infinite duration.
A sharp click has perfect time localization.
animations: Display two waveforms: a pure sine wave and a pulse [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tuningfork.svg].
Highlight the sine wave's localized frequency.
Highlight the pulse's broad time localization.
Animate the sine wave stretching indefinitely.
Animate the pulse collapsing into a thin spike [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drumstick.svg].

sections.title: Defining the Trade-off: Mathematical Visualization
lecture_lines: Define spread in time and frequency.
Observe the inequality: delta t times delta omega.
Squeeze time, and frequency spreads out.
Gaussian pulses visualize this trade-off clearly.
animations: Visualize a windowed sinusoid [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sinusoid.svg] on a 2D plot.
Reduce the window width to compress the pulse.
Show the frequency spectrum widening in response.
Draw a reciprocal curve [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sinusoid.svg] showing the trade-off.

sections.title: Why Can't We Have Both? The Phase Interference
lecture_lines: Precise frequency requires long signal cycles.
animations: Show two waves, one originating from an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/oscillator.svg], interfering to create a localized packet.
Demonstrate destructive interference outside the central region using the wave output from an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/oscillator.svg].
Highlight the constructive interference forming the pulse, effectively capturing the wave intensity as if recorded by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microphone.svg].

sections.title: Real-World Application: The Bat's Echolocation
lecture_lines: Bats balance time and frequency resolution.
animations: Animate a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bat.svg] emitting a frequency-modulated chirp.
Show the echo returning from a target insect to the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bat.svg].
Illustrate the time-of-flight calculation for distance based on the sound emitted by the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bat.svg].

sections.title: Summary & Reflection
lecture_lines: Uncertainty is inherent to wave motion.
It is not a sensor limitation.
Observation through waves has a tax.
animations: Summarize the trade-off with a simple 2x2 grid using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg] to represent input data.
Display final text: 'Precision depends on your goal.' using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg] as a visual marker.
